privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How this website handles enquiry details and saved homes.
sections: Information entered in the preview
The current enquiry form is a preview. Details entered in the form are checked in the page but are not sent to Aaramv or stored as an enquiry.
Saved homes
Saved homes are kept in your browser on the same device. Remove a home by selecting its heart icon again. Clearing browser storage may remove your saved list.
Third party content
Some project images and maps may load from third-party services. Those services may receive technical information needed to display their content.
Before a live enquiry service is enabled
The policy must identify the actual operator, information collected, purpose, contact channels, recipients or processors, retention approach, deletion process and a working privacy contact.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: The role of this website and the information to confirm before a property transaction.
sections: Using the website
Aaramv Realty provides property discovery, shortlist support and coordination for buyers in Bengaluru. Website content helps you compare options and start a conversation.
Property information
Project details, configurations, availability, prices and timelines may change. Review the current documents for the phase and home you are considering.
Our role

Aaramv acts as a real estate channel partner and provides advisory assistance. Construction, allotment, purchase terms, warranties and handover obligations remain governed by the relevant developer or seller documents.
Enquiries and visits
An enquiry is not a booking, allotment or confirmed appointment. Site access and timing must be agreed separately. In preview mode, the form does not send an enquiry.
Fees and commercial relationships
Before proceeding, ask for a written explanation of applicable service fees and developer or seller commission for your transaction.
Buyer review
Review the selected home's cost sheet, plans, registration details, payment schedule, cancellation terms and handover conditions with the relevant qualified professionals.
Images and plans
Photographs, artist impressions, show-apartment images and plans must be identified accurately. Furniture or fit-outs shown in an illustrative image are not automatically included in an offer.

contactFaqs.question: Does this confirm a site visit?
contactFaqs.answer: No. Access and timing must be agreed separately.

contactFaqs.question: Can I enquire while I am still exploring?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes. Share the budget, areas or priorities you already know, and use Help me decide for your home type.

contactFaqs.question: What happens to my request?
contactFaqs.answer: In preview mode no enquiry is sent or stored. After a live enquiry service is connected, the page must explain the actual contact and data-handling process.

contactFaqs.question: Are there any service fees?
contactFaqs.answer: Ask for a written explanation of any applicable service fee and developer or seller commission for your transaction before you proceed.

visitCopy: Check the approach road, surrounding uses, utilities and ongoing construction from the actual project entrance. Visit at a time that reflects your normal routine. Planned infrastructure and operating infrastructure must be shown separately.
